title: Microsoft Teams: automatic recording and transcription options follow meeting policies
summary: The policy combinations, rollout windows, automatic delivery and existing recording controls are supported. Add the policy-assignment control missing from the checklist's table, and clarify that using meeting options in sensitivity labels also requires Teams Premium.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: When recording is on and transcription is off, the recording has no transcript file stored next to it.
claims.quote: If recording is turned on, but transcription is turned off, the recording doesn't have a transcript file stored next to it.

claims.claim: Captions cannot be turned on in Stream playback of a recording made with transcription off.
claims.quote: Also, when viewing the recording playback in Stream, captions can't be turned on.

claims.claim: Private meeting recordings are uploaded to the organiser's OneDrive.

claims.claim: Channel meeting recordings are stored in the channel's SharePoint site.

claims.claim: The separate ExplicitRecordingConsent meeting-policy parameter can require consent to recording or transcription in meetings created by organisers assigned the policy.
claims.quote: To require participants to give their explicit consent to be recorded or transcribed in any meeting that organizers with this policy create, run the following command: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -ExplicitRecordingConsent Enabled

claims.claim: Microsoft has not described the interaction between explicit recording consent and the new automatic choices.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams "Record only" "AutoRecording" "ExplicitRecordingConsent" webinars sensitivity labels templates; read recording policies and participant-agreement search excerpts. General auto-recording consent is covered, but not the new choices.

claims.claim: An automatic option starts the chosen activity without someone starting it manually during the meeting.
claims.quote: A new Record only choice lets organizers automatically start recording without starting transcription.

claims.claim: Under the documented existing auto recording policy, the meeting option defaults to Off when the policy is enabled.
claims.quote: When you turn on the auto recording policy for an organizer, the meeting option for Record and transcribe automatically is Off by default.

claims.claim: Organisers must enable the existing automatic recording option separately for each meeting.
claims.quote: Organizers must manually enable Record and transcribe automatically setting for each meeting they want recorded and transcribed automatically.

claims.claim: The existing automatic recording setting defaults to On for webinars and town halls.
claims.quote: For webinars and town halls, the setting is On by default.

claims.claim: The organiser must have transcription enabled for the meeting to include a transcript.
claims.quote: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting. For meetings and events to include transcripts, the organizer must have this setting turned on.

claims.claim: The user starting the recording or transcript must also have transcription enabled.
claims.quote: The user who starts the recording or transcript must also have this setting turned on.

claims.claim: There is no documented direct admin-centre UI for the AutoRecording policy that controls visibility of the organiser's automatic setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams AutoRecording policy admin center PowerShell meeting template sensitivity label automatic recording Education A1 Teams Premium; opened auto recording and sensitive-meeting options. Visibility is managed in PowerShell; template enforcement is a separate route.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy with Identity and AutoRecording Enabled or Disabled controls access to the existing automatic recording setting.
claims.quote:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AutoRecording Enabled
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AutoRecording Disabled

claims.claim: The AutoRecording policy can be applied to users and groups.
claims.quote: You can only apply this policy setting to users and groups.

claims.claim: Learn distinguishes enforcing Record and transcribe automatically from the PowerShell policy controlling whether organisers see it.
claims.quote: There isn't an admin policy for Record and transcribe automatically. However, to control whether organizers have the Record and transcribe automatically setting in their Meeting options, you can use the Auto recording policy in PowerShell.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Meeting recording permission is configured in Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting recording.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. Select an existing policy or create a new one. Turn the Meeting recording toggle On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowCloudRecording accepts true or false to allow or prohibit meeting recording.
claims.quote:
To manage meeting recording by using PowerShell, use the -AllowCloudRecording parameter in Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy.
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowCloudRecording $true

claims.claim: Microsoft has not explicitly identified AllowCloudRecording as the parameter behind the notice's recording policy.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams "automatic recording" "choices" "AllowCloudRecording" "AllowTranscription"; read notice, recording policies and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy reference. They establish the general parameter, but not an explicit new-menu mapping.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Meeting transcription permission is configured in Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one. Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy with Identity and AllowTranscription true or false allows or prohibits meeting transcription.
claims.quote:
To manage meeting transcription using PowerShell, use the -AllowTranscription parameter in Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy.
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: Microsoft has not explicitly identified AllowTranscription as the parameter behind the notice's transcription policy.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams "automatic recording" "choices" "AllowCloudRecording" "AllowTranscription"; read notice, transcription documentation and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy reference. No explicit new-menu parameter mapping is given.

claims.claim: A meeting template can enforce automatic recording.
claims.quote: If there are certain types of meetings that should always be recorded, you can enforce this option by using a meeting template or a sensitivity label.

claims.claim: A sensitivity label can enforce automatic recording.
claims.quote: If all of a particular type of meeting must be recorded (for example, all sensitive meetings), consider enforcing this option by using a sensitivity label.
claims.fix: After naming the enforcement routes, add 'Meeting options in sensitivity labels also require Teams Premium.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/meeting-templates-sensitivity-labels-policies, which states 'Meeting options in sensitivity labels and custom meeting templates require Teams Premium.' Keep this separate from licensing of the new menu.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented how template or sensitivity-label enforcement interacts with the new options.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams "Record only" "AutoRecording" "ExplicitRecordingConsent" webinars sensitivity labels templates; opened sensitive-meeting options and auto recording; read templates/labels/policies excerpts. General enforcement is covered, but not its new-menu interaction.

claims.claim: Meeting policies can be assigned to users or groups in the Teams admin center.
claims.quote: To specific users: Select your policy, select Manage users > Assign users ... To groups: Go to the Group policy assignment tab, select Add, enter the group name, select the policy name, and then select Apply.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Every control the governance checklist asks readers to review is represented in the controls table.
claims.quote: 'Review policy assignments to users and groups so the effective policy for each organiser group is the one you intend.' The four table rows cover automatic-setting visibility, recording, transcription and a tenant switch, but none covers assignments.
claims.fix: Add a meeting-policy-assignment row. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/meeting-recording and use Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Manage users > Assign users. In the note, give the Group policy assignment > Add route for groups.

claims.claim: AllowCloudRecording does not configure or validate recording storage.
claims.quote: -AllowCloudRecording controls whether users can record meetings; it doesn't configure or validate recording storage.
